method.browser: Playwright-bundled Chromium, headed, fresh temporary profile
method.mechanism: Temporary Manifest V3 extension calls chrome.tabs.setZoom(tabId, 2) and independently reads chrome.tabs.getZoom(tabId)
method.note: The browser zoom setting is changed through Chromium tab zoom, not CSS/device emulation. CSS viewport and devicePixelRatio are measured from the rendered page after the browser reports zoom factor 2.

method.browser: Playwright-bundled Firefox 155.0, headless, fresh temporary profile, direct WebDriver BiDi session over loopback
method.mechanism: Temporary unsigned Firefox WebExtension sets browser.browserSettings.zoomFullPage=false and browser.tabs.setZoom(tabId, 2); extension reads both settings back. This is Firefox native Zoom Text Only, not CSS/font-size/viewport/device-scale emulation.
method.source: Mozilla documents Zoom Text Only and browserSettings.zoomFullPage=false as applying zoom to text only.
method.browserProfile: Fresh profile under OS temporary directory; browser.zoom.full and browser.zoom.siteSpecific are controlled only by the temporary extension and discarded on close.
method.expected: At fixed CSS viewport and DPR, representative computed text sizes reach 2x; text wraps without clipping/overlap, page does not overflow horizontally, target controls remain visible/focusable, no frontend write request or uncaught page error occurs.

limits: Affected R04/R05/R06 profiles only; separate native browser and native text methods. No CSS zoom substitution or screen-reader speech claim.
